Title: Fewer than 1% of the HTTP requests fail under load
Preconditions: The demo service https://quickpizza.grafana.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: ramp to 10 VUs in 1 min, hold 3 min, ramp down 30 s. Report run: 3 VUs, ramp 5 s, hold 15 s, ramp down 5 s (`-e VUS=3 -e RAMP_UP=5s -e HOLD=15s -e RAMP_DOWN=5s`)
Steps: 1. Run `k6 run scripts/load.js`. 2. Read the end-of-test summary.
Expected Result: Threshold `http_req_failed: rate<0.01` holds. Less than 1% of all HTTP requests failed.

Title: 95% of the requests answer in under 1500 ms and 99% in under 3000 ms under load
Preconditions: The demo service https://quickpizza.grafana.com is reachable
Test Data: Default: ramp to 10 VUs in 1 min, hold 3 min, ramp down 30 s. Report run: 3 VUs, ramp 5 s, hold 15 s, ramp down 5 s (`-e VUS=3 -e RAMP_UP=5s -e HOLD=15s -e RAMP_DOWN=5s`)
Steps: 1. Run `k6 run scripts/load.js`. 2. Read the end-of-test summary.
Expected Result: Threshold `http_req_duration: p(95)<1500, p(99)<3000` holds. The 95th percentile is under 1500 ms and the 99th percentile is under 3000 ms.
